property_summary: A successful transfer call (one that does not revert) always returns true.
A successful transfer call (one that does not revert) always returns true.
A successful transfer call (one that does not revert) always returns the same boolean value as the length of the _tos array being greater than 0 (which is true).
For any successful call, the return value equals the boolean value of the require condition (which is always true).
For any valid input that does not revert, the function transfer should return true only if the tos array is non-empty.
When transfer is called with an empty tos array, the reference reverts but the mutant returns true.
For any input, the function transfer returns the same boolean value as the input condition _tos.length > 0.
The function transfer should revert when the tos array is empty.
When transfer is called with an empty tos array and a valid (non-empty) v array, the reference reverts but the mutant returns true.
After a call to transfer, all intended recipients in the _tos array have received their respective token amounts via transferFrom.
After a call to transfer, the function returns true and the number of successful transfers made via caddress equals the length of _tos.
After a call to transfer, the sum of all transfers made via caddress equals the sum of all amounts in v.
After a call to transfer, the function returns true and no revert occurs for any input satisfying the require condition.
After a call to transfer, the number of successful transferFrom calls made equals the length of the _tos array.
